CA.name: Bitterroot
CA.citation: Native range confirmed to include southern British Columbia (American Gardener; Discover Lewis & Clark). Note: the historically recorded 'Salish name' spat'lum is NOT included here - Wikipedia (citing sourced scholarship) notes this was likely actually a Salishan word for tobacco, misattributed to this plant by Pursh, not a genuine name for bitterroot

GB.name: Bitter root
GB.citation: Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) plant record, Lewisia rediviva listed as "bitter root"; genuine UK alpine/rock-garden trade presence, though PFAF notes it is not reliably hardy outdoors in Britain

US.name: Bitterroot
US.citation: Montana Native Plant Society; state flower of Montana. Culturally significant to the Salish, Kootenai, and Shoshone peoples
